entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Get me an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. I can definitely help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It was delivered 20 days ago. I just need the return label.
Okay, pulling that up now... I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Before I proceed, can I quickly ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Look, it's neither. I tried to return this 11 days ago, on the 9th day I had it, but your entire return portal was showing a **website error**. Your whole **system was down**.
I understand your frustration. Let me check our system logs for that period. Can you confirm the date you tried to make the return?
December 26th. I have a **screenshot** of the error page if you need it.

Thank you for that. One moment... Yes, I can confirm we had a known outage on that date. It says here customers **couldn't print** labels for several hours. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
Let me just review the policy here... Okay, our records show all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
So, are you processing it or not?

Yes, absolutely. Since you received it 20 days ago, you are well within that 90-day window. I've approved the return and made a note about the system outage. The return label has just been sent to the email address on file. You should have it now.
Okay, I see the email. Finally. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
